release_notes: Build 52 adds a verified one-time migration from the development checkout into the installed Factburst Quiz Manager data folder.
The migration now chooses the legacy database with real library/quiz content instead of stopping when an empty bootstrap database already exists.
Saved settings and protected API credentials are carried across with the database on the same Windows user account.
The configured quiz projects folder is copied into persistent installed storage, verified, and the source project files are left untouched as a rollback copy.
Quiz History project paths and managed quiz-question image paths are rebased to the new installed locations so reopened projects and logo questions keep working.
An existing installed database containing user records is never overwritten by the migration, and a completion marker prevents repeat migrations after success.
